transcript.content: Hi, I’m glad you came in today. What brings you in?

I... I came in because I keep having thoughts that maybe it’d be better if I just didn’t wake up. And sometimes it feels like dying would be... fair, I guess. Like punishment for what I’ve done to my family and my crew.
Do you have unwanted memories or nightmares about a traumatic event?
I don’t... I don’t think so. Not like that. I mean, I have bad dreams sometimes, but I don’t know if they’re about anything specific.
Did something happen to you where you thought you might die or be seriously injured?
I’m not sure. I mean… I’ve had scary situations at work, I guess, but nothing that I’d call that. Nothing I can point to like that.
Have you ever had a period when you felt unusually high, energized, or irritable for several days in a row?
I don’t know… not really. I get irritable, I guess, but I wouldn’t say high or energized for days. Not that I’ve noticed.
Did these feelings start after a specific stressful event happened?
Yeah… I think so. It’s been about a year and a half, maybe a little less. Since my husband hurt his back and got mostly stuck at home.
Are you still feeling this depressed now?
Yeah… I am. It’s kind of just been there. I guess it started a few months after my husband got hurt, so… about a year and two months now.
Before this began after your husband’s injury, had you ever gone through a separate period in your life when you felt depressed like this?
I’m not really sure. I mean… I’ve had rough times before, but I don’t know if it was like this. Nothing that stands out the same way.
Do your mood symptoms feel mainly focused on your husband’s injury and its effects on your life?

Mostly, yeah. It’s tied up in that… but it feels bigger now. I keep thinking I caused all of it somehow—him getting worse, the crew losing work, even clients’ homes getting messed up. Like everything I touch goes bad. I don’t know… like I deserve whatever happens.
Before your husband was injured, was there ever a time in your life when you felt depressed most of the day nearly every day for at least two weeks?
I don’t really know. I can’t think of a time like that before… not clearly, anyway.
Before your husband’s injury, was there ever a time when you felt depressed nearly every day for at least two weeks?
I don’t think so. I mean, I’ve been sad before, but… not nearly every day for weeks, not that I can remember.
Have you lost interest or pleasure in things you usually care about or enjoy?
Yeah… I guess so. I used to paint, cook, go running before jobs, go to theater rehearsal… now it all just feels like chores from somebody else’s life. I don’t really care if I miss it.
Have you ever heard a voice when no one was there telling you that you deserve to die or be punished?

Not… not exactly those words. I do hear a man’s voice sometimes, like behind me at a job site or in my kitchen. It’ll say things like, “You missed it,” or “Everyone knows.” It sounds real, but when I turn around, there’s nobody there.
Have you ever heard that man’s voice during a time when you were not feeling depressed?

Yeah… there was a period, a few weeks maybe, where I wasn’t crying all day. I was getting up, eating a little better. But I still heard him at work sometimes… and I still felt like clients and suppliers were tracking me.
Have you ever had a time when you needed much less sleep than usual and still felt full of energy?
I don’t think so. I mean… my sleep’s been bad, but I wouldn’t say I felt full of energy. Usually the opposite.
Before this current depression started, was there ever another time in your life when you felt depressed nearly every day for at least two weeks?
I’m not really sure. I’ve had low times before, yeah, but I don’t know if it was nearly every day for two weeks like that.
Before your husband was injured, did you ever have a separate period when you felt depressed nearly every day for at least two weeks?
I don’t really know. I had rough patches before, but I can’t say for sure it was like… every day for two weeks.
Before your husband was injured, did you ever have a time when you felt depressed most of the day nearly every day for at least two weeks?
I’m not sure. Before that, I had times I felt down, but I don’t really remember if it was most of the day, every day, for that long.
At any time, have you had these voices or felt people were tracking you for two weeks or longer when you were not depressed?

Yeah… there was a time, a few weeks I guess, where I wasn’t as depressed. I was getting up, eating a little more, not crying all day. But I still heard the voice at work, and I still felt like the clients and suppliers were tracking me.
